package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestTaskRepositoryProjectionLoadsOrderedLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	source, err := os.ReadFile("task_repo_pg.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, fragment := range []string{"FROM task_learning_target tlt", "AS learning_targets", "ORDER BY tlt.\"order\", tlt.target_type, tlt.target_key, tlt.target_version"} {
		if !strings.Contains(string(source), fragment) {
			t.Fatalf("task projection is missing %q", fragment)
		}
	}
	targets, err := parseTaskLearningTargets([]byte(`[{"task_id":"task-1","type":"concept","key":"go.interfaces","version":"v1","order":0}]`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse targets: %v", err)
	}
	if len(targets) != 1 || targets[0] != (domain.TaskLearningTarget{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1", Order: 0}) {
		t.Fatalf("targets = %#v", targets)
	}
}

func TestTaskLearningTargetProjectionFailsClosedForMalformedOrInvalidTargets(t *testing.T) {
	for _, raw := range [][]byte{
		[]byte(`not-json`),
		[]byte(`[{"type":"concept","key":"go.interfaces","version":"v1"},{"type":"concept","key":"go.interfaces","version":"v1"}]`),
		[]byte(`[{"type":"unknown","key":"go.interfaces","version":"v1"}]`),
	} {
		if _, err := parseTaskLearningTargets(raw); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("invalid target projection %s was accepted", raw)
		}
	}
}
